title: LBCC study-materials flashcard deck
description: Schema 2.0, adapted from the ELECT 245 study-pack format. Card ids are permanent: never reuse or renumber them, so Anki review history survives deck updates.

deck.description: Display name, e.g. 'Unit 16: Inductance in AC Circuits'

deck_id.description: Prefix used by every card id in the deck

format.description: text: front/back are plain text and get escaped. html: front/back are trusted HTML fragments.

order.description: Sort key within the class on the web page

study_guide.description: Path to the matching study guide, relative to the deck file

section.description: Topic heading; cards are grouped by section in the order sections first appear

difficulty.description: 1 = big picture, 2 = core rule, 3 = detail, calculation or exception

front.description: Question. For cloze: text with {{c1::answer}} markers

back.description: Answer. For cloze: extra info. For mcq: the explanation

note.description: Short hint or extra fact shown under the answer

image.description: Path relative to the deck file

image_on_front.description: Show the image as (part of) the question instead of with the answer
